files.sourceEnglishTranscript: Ana meets Luis at the door of an evening class. Ana says, Hi, I’m Ana. What’s your name? Luis answers, I’m Luis. Nice to meet you. Ana says, Nice to meet you too. I’m from Peru, and I live in Lima. Luis replies, I’m from Chile. See you in class.

At the community desk, Rosa points to a photo. Rosa says, This is my colleague Diego. Omar asks, Who is the woman beside him? Rosa answers, That is our manager, Elena. The blue folder is hers, and the red folder is mine. Omar points to a badge and asks, Is this your badge? Rosa says, Yes, it is.

After class, Elena gives her contact to Marco. Elena says, My phone number is five five five, zero one four two, and my email is elena dot ramos at example dot org. Marco asks, When are you free? Elena says, I’m free on Tuesday at six, or Saturday morning. Marco replies, Tuesday at six works for me. I’ll send a message. They write the details on a small card.

During an orientation, Paula says, The appointment is on Thursday at three thirty. Tom does not understand. He says, Sorry, could you repeat that, please? Paula repeats, Thursday at three thirty. Tom asks, Do you mean this Thursday? Paula answers, Yes, this Thursday. The room is two oh four. Tom repeats the room number to check it.
